acad.evidence: Vehicle access for Stargazing at Cadillac Summit is managed by a Vehicle Reservation System from May to October, and the road closes each night at 9:00 pm.
acad.note: From May to October, driving up Cadillac Mountain needs a vehicle reservation, and the summit road closes each night at 9 p.m. Overnight parking is not allowed, but you may hike or bike to the summit.
acad.title: Cadillac summit road closes at 9 p.m.

acad.evidence: From December 1 to April 14, the majority of the Park Loop Road is closed to vehicles for the winter.
acad.note: From December 1 to April 14, most of the Park Loop Road is closed to cars for the winter.
acad.title: Park Loop Road closed in winter

blca.evidence: The South Rim Road is usually open to vehicles from late-April to mid-November. In winter, the South Rim Road is open to Gunnison Point at the visitor center.
blca.note: The South Rim Road is usually open to cars from late April to mid-November. In winter it is plowed only to Gunnison Point at the visitor center; beyond it the road is open to skiing and snowshoeing when conditions permit.
blca.title: South Rim Road beyond the visitor center closed in winter

crla.evidence: These roads close for the season with the first big snowstorm, or on November 1, whichever comes first.
crla.note: Rim Drive and the North Entrance Road close to cars with the first big snowstorm or on November 1, whichever comes first. Plowing usually starts in mid-April, and all roads are typically open by mid-July.
crla.title: Rim Drive closed in winter

ever.evidence: The park remains open 24 hours, but vehicles do not have access after 6:00 PM.
ever.note: Shark Valley is open to cars from 8:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. The main entrance, toward Royal Palm and Flamingo, is open 24 hours.
ever.title: Shark Valley closed to cars after 6 p.m.

glac.evidence: Lower portions of Going-to-the-Sun Road are open year-round, but the entire road does not usually open until late June or early July, and the Logan Pass area is not accessible by vehicle until then.
glac.note: Going-to-the-Sun Road does not usually open over Logan Pass until late June or early July, and, conditions permitting, stays fully open until the third Monday in October. The section from West Glacier to Lake McDonald Lodge is usually open all year.
glac.title: Logan Pass closed to cars until early summer

grba.evidence: During the winter, this road is impassible, and is closed to vehicle traffic at the Upper Lehman Campground.
grba.note: In winter the scenic drive closes to cars at Upper Lehman Creek Campground, which cuts off Mather Overlook. The road is usually open by Memorial Day weekend.
grba.title: Wheeler Peak Scenic Drive closed above Upper Lehman in winter

grsm.evidence: Cades Cove Loop Road is open sunrise to sunset each day, but closed to vehicles each Wednesday typically from May through September.
grsm.note: The Cades Cove Loop Road is open to cars from sunrise to sunset, and is closed to vehicles on Wednesdays, typically May through September.
grsm.title: Cades Cove Loop Road closed to cars after sunset

hale.evidence: A sunrise reservation is required for entry between 3am and 7am daily.
hale.note: The summit district is open 24 hours, but entering between 3 and 7 a.m. needs a sunrise reservation made in advance.
hale.title: Sunrise reservation needed to enter 3 to 7 a.m.

jeff.evidence: The park grounds are open from 5:00am –11:00pm year round.
jeff.note: The park grounds are open from 5 a.m. to 11 p.m. every day of the year.
spots: Arch Visitor Center West Entrance Plaza
jeff.title: Arch grounds closed 11 p.m. to 5 a.m.

lavo.evidence: The park highway closes to through traffic at one mile from both the Northwest Entrance and Southwest Entrance in the winter and early spring seasons (approximately December through May) due to snow.
lavo.note: From about December through May, the park highway is closed one mile in from each entrance. Kohm Yah-mah-nee Visitor Center and the Loomis area stay reachable by car.
lavo.title: Park highway closed by snow in winter and spring

mora.evidence: The Paradise area is closed overnight during the winter. Typically, Paradise is open over night from May-November.
mora.note: In winter, Paradise can be reached by car only in the daytime. NPS gives its overnight season as typically May to November; nightly gate closures at Longmire usually begin in late October or early November.
mora.title: Paradise closed overnight in winter

mora.evidence: Stevens Canyon Road is open during the summer only, typically from late May to October.
mora.note: Stevens Canyon Road is open only in summer, typically from late May to October.
mora.title: Stevens Canyon Road open in summer only

mora.evidence: The Sunrise Road usually opens in late June or early July and closes in late September to early October.
mora.note: Sunrise Road usually opens in late June or early July and closes in late September to early October.
mora.title: Sunrise Road open in summer only

olym.evidence: All vehicles must be below the Heart O' the Hills entrance station by 5 pm during the winter season.
olym.note: In the winter season, generally late November through March, Hurricane Ridge Road typically opens 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. Friday to Sunday, and every vehicle must be back below the Heart O' the Hills entrance by 5 p.m.
olym.title: Hurricane Ridge daytime only in winter

pefo.note: The park road is open from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Mountain Standard Time all year.
pefo.title: Park road open 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.

pinn.evidence: Note that camping is not permitted on the West Side, but the entrance is open for day use from 7:30 am to 8:00 pm, Pacific Time.
pinn.note: The west side is day-use only, with the gate open 7:30 a.m. to 8 p.m. The east side, with Bacon Ranch and Peaks View, has 24-hour access to trails.
pinn.title: West entrance gate closes at 8 p.m.

romo.evidence: Timed Entry + Bear Lake Road Reservations are required to enter the Bear Lake Road Corridor between the hours of 5 a.m. and 6 p.m. MDT.
romo.note: In season (in 2026, from May 22 to mid-October), entering the Bear Lake Road corridor from 5 a.m. to 6 p.m., or the rest of the park from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m., needs a timed entry reservation. Arriving after 6 p.m. needs none.
romo.title: Daytime timed entry; none needed after 6 p.m.

sagu.evidence: The Cactus Forest Loop Drive is open from 5:00am to 8:30pm year-round.
sagu.note: In the Rincon Mountain District, the Cactus Forest Loop Drive is open from 5 a.m. to 8:30 p.m. all year. Hohokam and Golden Gate roads in the Tucson Mountain District are open dawn to dusk.
sagu.title: Cactus Forest Loop Drive closes at 8:30 p.m.

sequ.evidence: This road generally opens by the Wednesday before Memorial Day in late May and closes for winter once it becomes impassable due to snow.
sequ.note: The Moro Rock and Crescent Meadow road generally opens by late May and closes once snow makes it impassable. When summer shuttles run, it closes to private cars on weekends and holidays from morning through late afternoon.
sequ.title: Moro Rock road closed in winter

yell.evidence: Most park roads are closed to regular vehicles from early November to late-April, and are open to limited oversnow travel (commercially-guided snowmobiles and snowcoaches) from mid-December to mid-March.
yell.note: From early November to late April, most park roads, including the road from the West Entrance to Madison, are closed to cars. When roads are open, entrances are not gated at night.
yell.title: Interior roads closed to cars in winter

yose.evidence: The Glacier Point Road is open to cars approximately late May through October or November, depending on conditions.
yose.note: Glacier Point Road is open to cars from about late May through October or November, depending on conditions.
yose.title: Glacier Point Road closed in winter and spring

yose.evidence: Open approximately late May or June to November, drive up Tioga Road to experience stargazing at higher elevations of Yosemite
yose.note: Tioga Road, the park's high-elevation stargazing drive, is open from about late May or June to November.
yose.title: Tioga Road closed in winter and spring

source: National Park Service, nps.gov park pages (public domain). Conditions change; check the park's alerts before you go.
